# every song is a website

> Explore songs as interactive websites with visual worlds, draggable objects, and embedded music videos. Pick a song and step inside.

Lyrics remain in the official Genius embed; Markdown links to Genius without copying embedded lyrics. Interactive layout and motion preferences are local browser state and are not exported.

<!-- Keep in sync with robots.txt and ai.txt. -->
